findings.title: Platform override flag and disabled list unused
findings.problem: PLATFORM_MODEL_OVERRIDE_ENABLED and PLATFORM_DISABLED_MODELS are defined (os.getenv at class-definition time) but grep of src finds no consumer. Tier 1 reads only ApplicationEnrichment.disabled_model_ids, set-time validation ignores the global list, and endpoints never return 501 when the flag is false (spec 7.2, AC5, AC7).
findings.impact: Operators setting the documented env vars see no effect; globally disabled models can still be granted and served, violating the hard-stop tier.
findings.recommendation: Gate the router/endpoints on PLATFORM_MODEL_OVERRIDE_ENABLED (501 when false), union PLATFORM_DISABLED_MODELS into the tier-1 check and into _validate_override_models, and load the settings as pydantic fields.

findings.title: Model and repository deviate from spec
findings.problem: UserModelOverride uses date/update_date instead of created_at/updated_at (also in the API response), user_id is str not UUID, adds an unused default_model column; repository lives in src/codemie/repository/ instead of data/repositories/ and has no query by user_id alone; resolve_model_for_user is absent from the service; set-time subset check is skipped when the project has no whitelist.
findings.impact: API contract and package layout differ from the approved spec; a maintainer must decide whether the spec or the code is authoritative.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether to align code with spec (rename columns, move repository, add methods) or amend the spec; then apply consistently, including the no-whitelist subset behavior.

findings.title: KeyError when resolved model not a candidate
findings.problem: selected = self.candidates[resolved_model] is unguarded; the resolver may return project.default_model, which need not be a router candidate. Enforcement is also truthiness-gated on user_id/project_name/session, so partial context silently skips it.
findings.impact: LLM call aborts with KeyError for projects whose default is outside the router's candidates; partial context bypasses enforcement without a log.
findings.recommendation: Fall back to self.default_model (with a warning log) when resolved_model is not in self.candidates, and log when user context is partial.

findings.title: Enrichment repository sync and has no caller
findings.problem: ApplicationEnrichmentRepository uses sync Session.query while the resolver reads ApplicationEnrichment via AsyncSession; nothing in src calls it and its tests use only MagicMock chains. No code path can populate disabled_model_ids.
findings.impact: Tier-1 platform disablement can never trigger in practice; calling the repo with an AsyncSession raises AttributeError.
findings.recommendation: Convert to AsyncSession with select()/await (matching UserModelOverrideRepository), provide a write path for disabled_model_ids, and add an async-session test.

findings.title: Error mapping returns wrong status codes
findings.problem: Handlers catch only (ModelNotWhitelistedException, NotFoundException) and map both to 400; ValueError from the service (blank models) and IntegrityError from concurrent inserts fall into the generic except and become 500.
findings.impact: Client errors and races surface as 500; missing users/projects return 400 instead of 404.
findings.recommendation: Map NotFoundException to 404, ValueError to 400 and IntegrityError to 409, with rollback; validate model ids as non-blank in the request model.

findings.title: List endpoint pagination unbounded
findings.problem: skip and limit are plain ints with no bounds and the query has no order_by.
findings.impact: Negative skip causes DB errors, huge limit dumps the table, and pagination is unstable.
findings.recommendation: Use Query(0, ge=0) and Query(100, ge=1, le=500) and add a deterministic order_by.

findings.title: Batch failure body and revoke result off-spec
findings.problem: Batch failure returns HTTPException(400, str(e)) instead of the BATCH_VALIDATION_FAILED body with failed_user_id, reason, operation and user_ids (AC9); revoke returns an empty list instead of the deleted records (AC4); empty user_ids yields 422 rather than 400.
findings.impact: Admins cannot identify which user failed a batch, and a revoke is indistinguishable from a no-op; required acceptance criteria are unmet.
findings.recommendation: Return the structured BATCH_VALIDATION_FAILED error body, return the deleted overrides from revoke, dedupe and cap user_ids, and reject unknown operations.

findings.title: Async resolution contradicts spec non-goal
findings.problem: The spec lists synchronous, non-async model resolution as a non-goal, yet resolve_model_for_execution_with_user_context, the service and repository are all async. It also calls the sync Application.get_by_id inside the async function.
findings.impact: Behavior contradicts the approved spec; mixing a sync DB call into async code blocks the event loop and uses another session.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether the async conversion is accepted (amend spec) or reverted; either way remove the sync Application.get_by_id call from the async path.

findings.title: Tier 4 default model not checked for disablement
findings.problem: Tier 4 returns project.default_model without checking ApplicationEnrichment.disabled_model_ids; the user override's own default_model is stored but never used.
findings.impact: A platform-disabled model can be served as the fallback, violating the hard-stop tier.
findings.recommendation: Check project.default_model against the disabled list (and the global list) before returning it, raising ModelNotWhitelistedException if disabled; decide how override.default_model is used.

findings.title: User context never reaches model resolver
findings.problem: invoke_args uses hasattr(self.user, 'user_id') but the security User exposes only 'id'; the session is taken from 'with get_session()' and used after the block closes it, and is a sync Session passed to code that awaits session.execute; failures are logged at debug. invoke_task merges args into executor inputs, so delivery to RouterChatModel._agenerate kwargs is unconfirmed. Reachability of the closed-session path was confirmed in source; the kwargs delivery stayed unconfirmed.
findings.impact: Overrides and platform disablement are silently never enforced in workflow execution, or a closed sync session breaks resolution at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Use the correct user id attribute, provide an AsyncSession that stays open for the invoke, ensure the kwargs reach _agenerate, log a warning when context is missing, and add a test asserting invoke_task args.

findings.title: Endpoint tests miss gating and validation cases
findings.problem: No non-admin tests for GET/DELETE/batch, no single-POST validation 400, project 404, empty user_ids/allowed_models for batch, or delete-not-found; resolver tests patch Application.get_by_id and AgentNode args are never asserted.
findings.impact: AC12 unmet; regressions in gating and error mapping would not fail any test.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing endpoint cases and an AgentNode test asserting invoke_task receives user_id, project_name and a live session.
